bundlingNotes: Quoted: 'The rates shown are for the processing of the various types of escrows as required by Article 5.5 commencing with Section 12401 of the Insurance Code ... and do not include any additional service(s) unless otherwise noted.' Section A (General Rules): 'The charges set forth herein are minimum charges for ordinary services. Additional charges will be made when unusual or special services are requested.' Section D lists what Residential Sale Escrow Services *includes* (doc prep, subordination processing, standard overnight delivery, company courier without individual package charge, in-office document signing) and explicitly what it does NOT include: new loan services, notary fees, third-party/out-of-office signing, special-purpose couriers with individual charges, overnight delivery outside continental US, lender payoff/demand fees, and recording/transfer-tax/governmental fees. Document filed under the name 'Gateway Title Company' (the underlying operating entity for the Pacific Coast Title brand) per Section A's company-identification language.

bundlingNotes: Quoted (Section 10.2.1, Basic Escrow Service scope): 'Preparation of Escrow Instructions; Estimates of closing costs; Ordering demands; Pay secured obligations, as required; Pay up to three credit cards or unsecured debts; Amendments to the escrow instructions as required; Preparation of HUD-1, ALTA settlement statement and/or coordination of Closing Disclosure with Lender; Disburse proceeds to borrower and/or seller; Disburse funds per approved settlement statements; Coordinate borrower signing, if required.' All-Inclusive Residential Property Escrow (1-4 Family) adds to Basic: 'One (1) loan tie-in fee, Issuance of all payoff checks ... Required wire transfers, One electronic document download, Local messenger services (excluding special messengers), Up to four (4) overnight delivery services, Preparation of up to two (2) documents, Processing of one subordination, Lien/Judgment clearance services' for a flat fee premium built into the All-Inclusive rate tier vs. Basic. This is the most granularly itemized escrow fee schedule found in California this session — WFG explicitly separates ~20 individually priced 'Additional Processing Fees' (wire, e-doc, recording, notary, redraw, HOA, etc.) from the bundled Basic/All-Inclusive service tiers.
